values.note: Monona County Fair off-season camping: $25 a night, water and electric, no sewer.

note: Grass RV sites on the northwest corner of the Monona County fairgrounds in Onawa, run by the Monona County Fair Association. Off-season camping only: fair week is not sold. Enter from 15th St; campers report you can bump the curb to make a site a pull-through. --Claude
summary: Fair Association page confirms $25, water + electric, no sewer, request form, any date outside fair week. Ordinary nights look real: 2021, 2022 and fall 2026 campers. Ownership question: an association, not the county. Note cleaned. Not waterfront holds (no water).
flags: ORDINARY NIGHTS: real. Operator: 'Off season camping is any date outside of Fair week. The price is $25 per night.' Campers: RV Life 2022 'Nice overnight level grass parking with 30/50amp and seasonal water. No sewer or dump... So much better than KOA across the hiway at $63'; RV Life 2021 'They have off season rv spots at fairgrounds'; Google, a month ago, 'RV'd here for a few days'. Booked by request form, answer by reply; no calendar. Note the operator's form is the whole booking channel.

OWNERSHIP QUESTION: stored local, but the operator is the Monona County Fair Association (its own board of directors, PO Box 313 Onawa, sponsors, PayPal), not a county department; no county page mentions it that I found. I read it as a non-profit association, so `private` by the Wabash & Erie rule, though the site doesn't state its legal form. If private, it takes the private rule: presence passes (own website with the rate; Google open, 4.3 on 62 reviews, phone +1 712-423-2214 matches stored, though the website itself posts no phone), price passes ($25). RV Life 5.0 on 3, $$, 12 sites. Not borderline.

Google's pin for the listing is on the fair buildings; the stored pin at 15th St and the fairground map's CAMPGROUND label (NW corner) agree with each other. Pin good. Site count not published; RV Life says 12.
Water/electric may be seasonal: RV Life 2021 'Electric only through October 31', 2022 'seasonal water'. The operator doesn't state a season, so season left unset.
